verdict.rationale: Fireflies' security page claims Enterprise 'Private Storage' that stores meeting data 'at your preferred location' in dedicated cloud storage, which is a first-party data-location choice. It is Enterprise-only and described only in a single line of marketing copy, with no named regions or residency guarantees. missing for 10: list of selectable regions/residency options, documentation of how location is configured, availability beyond Enterprise tier, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Private Storage on Enterprise to store your meeting data at your preferred location.
Secure, dedicated cloud storage exclusively for your organization’s data.
